displayAddress: Sugar House, French Yard, Redcliff, Bristol, City of Bristol
description:
A stylish city-centre apartment offering contemporary living in a sought-after Bristol setting, moments from the Harbourside, vibrant amenities and excellent transport connections. An ideal choice for professionals, first-time buyers or investors. 

This impressive one-bedroom apartment forms part of a striking contemporary development in the heart of Bristol, combining a smart modern interior with an exceptionally convenient city-centre setting. Well presented throughout, the property offers excellent natural light and a stylish finish ideally suited to professionals, couples or buyers seeking a well-connected city base.

The spacious open-plan kitchen, dining and living area is a particular highlight, with attractive wood flooring and tall glazed doors creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. Juliet-style balconies enhance the sense of openness, while the generous proportions provide plenty of room for comfortable seating, dining and even a dedicated home-working area.

The contemporary kitchen is finished with sleek white cabinetry, contrasting work surfaces and integrated appliances, providing excellent storage and preparation space. A separate utility area adds further practicality and helps keep household essentials away from the main living space.

The double bedroom is well proportioned and benefits from extensive fitted wardrobes with sliding doors, alongside tall glazing bringing in further natural light. The bathroom is finished to a high standard with large-format grey tiling, a bath with shower over, contemporary sanitaryware and extensive mirrored detailing.

Please note residents also benefit from a concierge team, included within the service charge, providing a helpful additional level of convenience with services including secure key holding and parcel holding.

The apartment occupies a superb central position within easy reach of Bristol Harbourside, Queen Square and Wapping Wharf, placing an excellent selection of independent restaurants, cafes, bars and waterside walks close at hand. St Nicholas Market, the Old City and Cabot Circus provide further shopping, dining and entertainment within the wider city centre.

Bristol Temple Meads railway station is also conveniently accessible, providing mainline connections to destinations including London, Birmingham and Cardiff. The location is particularly well suited to those wishing to explore Bristol on foot or by bicycle, with the city's commercial, cultural and leisure districts all within easy reach. Nearby educational establishments include St Mary Redcliffe and Temple School and St Mary Redcliffe C of E Primary School, while the University of Bristol and City of Bristol College are also accessible from this central location.

Deposit

Sales can be secured with a reservation deposit of £5,000. This forms part of the final purchase price and is NOT an extra cost.

This deposit ensures that the property is taken off the market as soon as a sale is agreed. It is then exclusively reserved for you, eliminating gazumping, time wasting and financial loss.

An administration fee of £396 is required in order to draw up an exclusive legally binding contract between the buyer and seller. This gives the buyer exclusive rights to purchase within a pre-agreed timeframe.

Exclusivity

Following the payment of the above amount, Springbok Properties will facilitate a fixed exclusivity period (approximately 12 weeks). During this time, surveys should be arranged and preparations made for the exchange of contracts. The property will be reserved, so there will be no risk of gazumping.
